# awscc_networkflowmonitor_performance_monitor (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::NetworkFlowMonitor::PerformanceMonitor



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the performance monitor.
- `created_at` (String) The date and time when the performance monitor was created.
- `modified_at` (String) The date and time when the performance monitor was last modified.
- `monitor_name` (String) The name of the performance monitor.
- `monitor_status` (String) The status of the performance monitor.
- `monitor_type` (String) The type of the performance monitor.
- `scope_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the scope for the performance monitor.
- `tags` (Attributes List) The tags for the performance monitor. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `targets` (Attributes List) The targets that are monitored by the performance monitor. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--targets))
